title: Louisiana and New Orleans players and soul
summary: Lovett says New Orleans bands play all night without music, which is soul; Smith argues jazz arose in several cities at once.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: What about the guys down in Louisiana, man, New Orleans especially. They'd play from maybe eight o'clock to two in the morning and you don't see a piece of music over there. That's got to be soul.
Baby, tell us more about those cats down there.
Oh man, those guys man, they play -- everything they play, man you feel it, everything they play. That's what I call soul, man when you can just feel a thing man, you know what I mean.
